title: Traits the racial template states but the Typical Stats summary omits
summary: Completes the repair begun in 004. The authorized source states each creature's traits twice: once in the racial template (**Advantages:** and its companion lines) and again as a **Traits:** summary inside Typical Stats. The JSON conversion reads the summary and the GCS conversion reads the template, so wherever the summary is incomplete the published record and the .gct disagreed about the same creature. This restores 142 trait statements across 88 records, every one of them already present in the corresponding .gct. Costs are dropped because record traits state modifiers, not prices. Guards excluded 19 candidates that the record already expresses: natural weapons carried as attacks, constructions stated in attack notes, and source misspellings already present in the record (Resitricted Diet, infraivision, odious racial habie, nigh vision, discirminatory smell, constriciton attack, dobule-jointed, odious radial habit, doesn't breath). Eight records gain a rating input and are repriced: the seven Monstrous Centipede sizes gain High Pain Threshold and Dread Wraith gains Combat Reflexes. Every other record's CER is unchanged.
